label: Gender
description: A person's gender: woman, man, trans woman, trans man or non-binary person. Words for a woman fit woman and words for a man fit man; trans woman, trans man and non-binary person fit only words that say so. Words that name a kind of being or a role rather than a gender (an elf, a robot, a vampire, a chef, a farmer) say nothing about gender, so every item fits them.
notes: A comprehensive list: every value is browsable and pickable, and none is left out. It seeds a person's variants one value per variant, drawn by its shares: woman and man half each. Trans woman, trans man and non-binary person have share 0, so they are opt-in: drawn only when a person's words ask for one ('trans woman', 'non-binary') or a pick pins it, never as unasked variety. A person's words narrow it ('woman' keeps woman). Each value carries the presentation facet where it has one, so the rest of the vocabulary can be fitted to it. Not a slot's list: the reader never binds a slot to it; the chooser offers it beside descent for a person slot, and a pick pins it. A value's short form is what a person's variant must say of it ("non-binary").
